purpose: single declarative admission gate for future UTM-universe deployment settings

axioms.meaning: Every finite logical layer may be projected to one declared finite materialization substrate. Projection is not identity and does not create platform privilege.
Logical hierarchy may be potentially unbounded while normalized physical resource commitment remains finite in the declared substrate model.
Two potentially unbounded logical directions share a finite symbolic boundary representation Omega; this is compactification, not completed infinite computation.

compactified_infinite_deployment.authorization_boundary: internal computability and certification do not entail external platform authority

secret_policy: raw credentials/secrets are forbidden in proposals; use external secret references handled by the deployment platform

authorization.proposal_verification: automatic when all policy conditions pass
authorization.commit: requires explicit external authorization in addition to a valid certificate
authorization.external_apply: must be performed by an authenticated platform adapter such as GitHub/Railway; gateway certificate alone grants no platform privilege
authorization.authorization_blocked: a certified logical continuation remains preserved but physical materialization does not occur until the external platform grants the required role or credential
authorization.internal_computability: does not entail external platform authority

boundary: This gateway coordinates formal/declarative deployment intents. Compactification axioms, synchronized UTM.sh layers, and OMEGA_ADMITTED residents are formal hypotheses/computational representations only. They do not create infinite physical computation, infinite hardware, infinite energy, bypass platform authorization, decide undecidable problems, or make empirical claims true.

synchronized_formal_layers.coexistence_rule: imported Three-Universe A1/A2/A3 do not overwrite Compactified Infinite Deployment A1/A2/A3

omega_internal_deployment.semantics: logical/formal admission into a verified finite UTM-Omega stage
omega_internal_deployment.direct_limit: C_omega is a symbolic/direct-limit horizon over finite stages
omega_internal_deployment.authorization_boundary: OMEGA_ADMITTED does not grant GitHub/Railway/host privilege
